{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the trial data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/trial.csv')

# Identify the row with the highest sample_seq for each patient
# This ensures we keep only the latest (most complete) measurement per patient
trial_df_sorted = trial_df.sort_values('sample_seq', ascending=False)
trial_df_unique = trial_df_sorted.drop_duplicates(subset='patient_id', keep='first')

# Check the number of unique patients after deduplication
num_patients = len(trial_df_unique)

# Count how many had severe baseline disease
severe_count = trial_df_unique['severity'].value_counts().get('severe', 0)

# Calculate the fraction
fraction_severe = severe_count / num_patients

# Output results
num_patients, severe_count, fraction_severe"}
